records.title: AAPG Eastern Section Annual Meeting 2026
records.organization: Eastern Section of the American Association of Petroleum Geologists (ESAAPG)
records.description: The Eastern Section of AAPG holds its annual meeting for geoscientists across the eastern United States, covering conventional hydrocarbon exploration and production, unconventional resources, carbon sequestration and environmental solutions.

details.venueAddress: 1000 Corporate Drive, Canonsburg, PA 15317, United States

program.text: The official meeting page says registration includes an icebreaker, drink tickets, entertainment, dinner, exhibitors, breakfast and lunch for two conference days, and workshops.

callForPapers.text: The official ESAAPG site states that abstracts for the 2026 Eastern Section meeting were accepted through September 15, 2026, with guidelines on the submission page.

keynotes.text: Keynote speakers have not yet been announced on the official event pages.

committee.text: A conference-specific technical committee has not yet been announced on the official event pages.

fees.text: Current 2026 registration pricing has not yet been published on the official event pages.

sponsors.text: Named 2026 sponsors and exhibitors have not yet been announced on the official event pages.

community.text: The official meeting page lists an icebreaker, entertainment, dinner, exhibitors, shared breakfasts and lunches, and workshops as part of the attendee experience.

details.accommodation: The meeting venue is Hilton Garden Inn Pittsburgh/Southpointe.
